motions.purpose: Relate dish geometry to link performance: band, diameter, efficiency, elevation, and azimuth controls rebuild the 3D antenna and recompute gain, beamwidth, EIRP, and path terms from closed-form relations.
motions.model: Gain from aperture efficiency with feed-shadow and strut blockage terms; free-space path loss, clear-air zenith attenuation with air-mass scaling, specific rain attenuation, system noise temperature, Doppler, and light-time from the standard link-budget relations in comms-solver.mjs (band plan frozen in BANTLAR).
motions.limitations: Pattern and beam cone are geometric illustrations of the computed beamwidth, not a solved radiation pattern; atmospheric terms use simplified fits, not ITU-R interpolation tables; the ground scene is decorative.
motions.reducedMotion: The scene has no autonomous animation to reduce: nothing moves unless the user drags the camera or changes a control, so behavior is identical.
motions.exportState: ?export=1 hides controls and footer; ?t=N marks the frame via html[data-frozen-at]; the render is deterministic for identical URL parameters.
motions.accessibility: Native sliders and selects drive every parameter; all computed quantities are shown as text in the numbers panel, so the 3D view carries no information of its own; camera drag is optional.
